The challenge

From a leaf image
to a learning model.

Dṛṣṭi — sight. The name is the whole brief: teach a machine to see what a trained eye sees.

DRISHTI 1.0 brings undergraduate teams together for a leaf classification challenge organised by IIC-FIT Research Hub.

Work with labelled leaf images, develop your machine learning model at home, and test it against images you have not seen before. Your accuracy matters. So does your understanding of the model.

01

Register as a team

Form a team of 2–4 undergraduate students from the 2nd, 3rd or 4th year. Complete registration through the official Google Form by 29 October 2026.

02

Train at home

Registered teams receive labelled leaf images of K varieties on 29 October 2026. Use the training data to build your model. The number of varieties is awaiting confirmation.

03

Take the unseen test

An unseen test set is handed out on Challenge Day. Teams are judged on classification accuracy and their ability to explain their model.

Before you register

Rules & participation

These are the participation conditions stated in the event brochure. Read the complete rules in the registration form.

  1. Eligibility. Open to 2nd, 3rd and 4th year undergraduate students.
  2. Team size. Each team must have a minimum of 2 and a maximum of 4 members.
  3. Registration deadline. Registration closes on 29 October 2026. No entries will be accepted after this date.
  4. Training data. Labelled leaf images are released to registered teams on 29 October 2026. Train your model at home.
  5. Unseen evaluation. An unseen test set is handed out on Challenge Day.
  6. Judging. Teams are assessed on classification accuracy and their ability to explain their model.

Read the complete rules

The official brochure directs participants to the Google Form for the full rules and regulations. Review those instructions before submitting your registration.

A few useful answers

Participant questions

Who can participate?

2nd, 3rd and 4th year undergraduate students. Each team must have between 2 and 4 members.

Where do we register?

Use the official Google registration form. Registration opens on 14 October 2026 and closes on 29 October 2026.

When will we receive the training dataset?

The labelled leaf image dataset is scheduled for release to registered teams on 29 October 2026. Check the Downloads section and organiser updates for access instructions.

What happens on Challenge Day?

An unseen test set is handed out on 4 November 2026. Teams are judged on accuracy and on whether they can explain their model.

Is there a registration fee? What should we bring?

NO registration fee. Each team should bring only one laptop.

Where can we find the full rules?

Use the “Open official rules” button in the Rules section before registering.
